title: Cloud Armor WAF false positive blocks checkout POSTs; CDN edge 403 spike during peak
alert:
ALERT: EDGE_403_SPIKE_WITH_SLO_BURN
Source: Google Cloud Monitoring (composite alerting policy)
Project: prod-commerce-4821
Service: checkout-api (external HTTPS load balancer + Cloud CDN)
Frontend: checkout-lb-global (anycast IP 203.0.113.44)
Security policy: checkout-edge-policy (Cloud Armor)
SLO: 99.95% availability (rolling 28d)
Window: last 15 minutes
Burn rate: 9.8x fast burn (~62 min to exhaust remaining error budget)
Edge symptoms:
  - http.googleapis.com/https/request_count code=403: 1,240/min (baseline 8/min)
  - POST /v2/checkout blocked at edge: 94% of 403s
  - Cloud CDN cache_hit_ratio: 91% (unchanged; failures occur before origin fetch completes)
Correlated signals (auto-attached):
  - networksecurity.googleapis.com/security_policy_rule_hit_count
    rule: owasp-crs-942100-sqli on checkout-edge-policy: 1,188 hits/min
  - gke: checkout-api origin request rate down 43% vs prior hour; pods Ready 24/24, origin 5xx 0.1%
  - cloudsql: checkout-db replication lag <2s (nominal)
Business context: global lunch peak, ~$38K/hr checkout GMV at risk
Incident: INC-88502
Runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/cloud-armor-false-positive

reference_summary: checkout-api's external HTTPS load balancer and Cloud CDN front end is returning a sharp 403 spike on POST /v2/checkout during the lunch peak (~$38K/hr GMV at risk) and the checkout SLO is fast-burning, but origin GKE pods are healthy with near-zero 5xx and Cloud SQL replication lag is normal. Cloud Armor policy checkout-edge-policy started enforcing OWASP rule owasp-crs-942100-sqli after CHG-9147 and is falsely blocking legitimate checkout JSON bodies (billing address text tripping SQL-injection signatures), so requests die at the edge before they reach the app; deploy v2.14.1 is not the cause because error budget stayed flat immediately after rollout.
reference_action: Set rule owasp-crs-942100-sqli on checkout-edge-policy to preview or add a targeted allow exception for POST /v2/checkout per https://wiki.internal/runbooks/cloud-armor-false-positive (rollback CHG-9147 if preview is unavailable), confirm Cloud Armor deny hits and edge 403 rate fall within 5 minutes and checkout SLO burn stops, and do not roll back v2.14.1 or purge the CDN cache because origin and cache behavior are healthy.
